verifications.claim: U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) regular trading hours are 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The US stock market opens at 9:30 a.m. ET ... close at 4 p.m. ET" (R1); "9:30 AM 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST)" (R2); "9:30 AM – 4 PM Eastern time" (R3); "9:30 a.m. ET to 4:00 p.m. ET" (R4); "9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Eastern time" (R5); "9:30 AM 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST)" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the regular hours as 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET/EST for NYSE and Nasdaq.

verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on pre-market start: R4 supports 4 a.m. ET for Nasdaq but notes NYSE variation; R2 and R6 specify 7 a.m. ET.
